title: Suspicious PowerShell execution
description: powershell.exe launched with an encoded command from a user workstation shortly after a downloaded archive was opened.

title: Repeated failed logins followed by success
description: Nine failed sign-in attempts were followed by one successful sign-in for the same user from the same unfamiliar IP address.

title: Suspicious attachment blocked
description: An inbound message contained a blocked executable attachment. The attachment was quarantined before delivery.

title: Rapid mass file modification
description: A workstation modified 2,418 documents in 90 seconds and many filenames gained the same new extension.

title: Connection to newly observed domain
description: A workstation made repeated DNS requests to a domain first observed by the sensor today. No malware verdict is available.

title: UAC Bypass and Privilege Escalation
description: User launched fodhelper.exe, which can auto-elevate without a UAC prompt. A recent modification to the user's ms-settings registry data suggests it may have been used to launch a PowerShell payload and bypass User Account Control.
